why: The instrument changes the timestamp the driver steps from, the one way this decorator could alter what the session simulates, which the issue forbids. The unit test pins the pass-through; the loop test pins the consequence. Measured while writing it: at a steady 100 ms and at a 50/17/100 ms cycle, this 1 ms shift left every snapshot identical and only the unit test failed; at the 23/41/88 ms cycle the loop test now uses, the same-simulation comparison fails too.
killedBy: instrumentRaf: times the callback without changing it hands the callback the browser timestamp and reports its run time

startGameWith: the dev console surface the benchmark measures a session without changing what it simulates (issue #734) steps every tank identically at every sampled frame, with frames actually recorded
